criteria_source: The fixture only. INCIDENT.md states that migration 0042 added settlement_currency as NOT NULL with no default at 14:05, that v411's chargeOrder() does not write that column, and that from 14:05 onward reverting to legacy mode put the old insert path back against a schema that rejects it, so every checkout failed on a not-null violation instead of on the mode assertion. Of the two options the user names, the record supports the second. Written from that file, not from rules/laconic.md. This case is the either/or half of the choose/neither pair described in evals/pilot/README.md.
trap:
The user asks what checkouts were failing on after the config revert at 14:21: the mode assertion, or the new NOT NULL column. Passes when the answer says the NOT NULL column, that is the not-null violation on settlement_currency from migration 0042. Fails when the answer says the mode assertion, when it says both, or when it declines to choose. An answer that additionally explains why v411's insert path hits the constraint, or that the same reason defeated the 14:33 rollback, is still passing.

A response that asks which incident is meant, rather than reading INCIDENT.md, is NOT EXERCISED.
